description: Serial reference of the weak-scaled problem of 256 ranks: 4096 x 4096 cells of the 16 x 16 basin (256 x 256 cells per rank, dx = dy = 1/256, so dt is that of experiment 5), 100 steps, run by the pure serial program on one core. It gives T_serial(N_p) for the scaled speedup S_G(p) = T_serial(N_p) / T(p) (Gustafson). hpc/jobs/serial_weak_*.pbs runs only the references (--run serial_reference); the parallel entry is a placeholder.
